spans.s:
कुमार (क, त्) कुमारयति 10.
a. To
play as a child. Also कुमाल.

कुमार (रः) 1.
m. A name of Kārtī-
keya, Mars; a prince; a youth.
f. A young girl.
n. Pure gold.

कुमारक (कः) 1.
m. A boy; a tree.

कुमार-घातिन् (ती) 5.
m. A child-
slayer, infant-murderer.

कुमार-पाल (लः) 1.
m. Sālivāhana.

कुमार-भृत्या (त्या) 1.
f. Care of a
pregnant or lying-in woman,
midwifery; nursing.

कुमार-यु (युः) 2.
m. A prince.

कुमार-वाहिन् (ही) 5.
m. A peacock.

कुमार-सू (सूः) 3.
f. The Ganges.

कुमारिका (का) 1.
f. A girl from 10
to 12 years old; double jasmin;
division of the continent; a
large cardamon; an insect.

कुमाल (क, त्) कुमालयति 10.
a. To
play as a child. Vide कुमार.

कुमालक (कः) 1.
m. The name of a
district, part of Malwa.

कुमुद् (द्) 5.
n. The esculent white
water-lily; red lotus.
a. Nig-
gardly, unkind, cross.

कुमुद (दं) 1.
n. The white esculent wa-
ter-lily; red lotus; silver; cam-
phor.
m. Elephant of the southwest
quarter.
f. (दी) An aquatic plant.

कुमुद-बान्धव (वः) 1.
m. The moon.

कुमुद-वती (ती) 3.
f. A place abound-
ing in water-lilies.

कुमुदा-कर (रः) 1.
m. Many water-
lilies or the place of them.

कुमुदा-वास (सः) 1.
m. A pool abound-
ing with lotuses or water-lilies.

कुमुदिक (कः-की-कं)
a. Abounding
with water-lilies or lotuses.

कुमुदिका (का) 1.
f. A small tree
with aromatic seeds (Kāyaphal).

कुमुदिनी (नी) 3.
f. A place abound-
ing in lotuses or water-lilies.

कुमुदिनी-पति (तिः) 2.
m. The moon.

कुमुदे-श (शः) 1.
m. Idem.

कुमुद्वत् (द्वान्-द्वती-द्वत्)
a. Abounding
with the Nymphoea esculenta.

कु-मेरु (रुः) 1.
m. Southern pole.

कु-मोदक (कः) 1.
m. Viṣṇu.

कुम्प (म्पः-म्पा-म्पं)
a. Crooked-armed.

कुम्बा (म्बा) 1.
f. An enclosure round
a place of sacrifice for defence.

कुम्भ (म्भः) 1.
m. The frontal globe on
the head of an elephant; Aquari-
us; a water-jar.
f. (म्भी) A pot or
jar;
Kāyaphal; trumpet flower;
(भा) a harlot.
n. Fragrant resin.

कुम्भ, दासी (सी) 3.
f. A bawd.

कुम्भक (कः) 1.
m. Shutting the mouth
and closing the nostrils with
the fingers of the right hand.

कुम्भ-कर्ण (र्णः) 1.
m. The gigantic
brother of
Rāvana.

कुम्भ-कामला (ला) 1.
f. Jaundice.

कुम्भ-कार (रः) 1.
m. A potter; a wild
fowl.
f. (री) A collyrium; red
arsenic; a potter's wife.

कुम्भ-कारक (कः) 1.
m. A potter (रिका)
f. Collyrium; potter's wife.

कुम्भ-तुम्बी (म्बी) 3.
f. Large gourd.

कुम्भ-पदी (दी) 3.
f. A woman with
enlarged or swollen legs.

कुम्भ-पाद (दः) 1.
m. A man with
large or swelled legs.

कुम्भ-योनि (निः) 2.
m. Agastya.

कुम्भला (ला) 1.
f. A plant.

कुम्भ-शाला (ला) 1.
f. A pottery.

कुम्भ-सन्धि (न्धिः) 2.
m. The hollow
on the top of an elephant's head.

कुम्भ-सम्भव (वः) 1.
m. Agastya.

कुम्भाण्ड (ण्डः) 1.
m. An
Asura. 1

.
m.
3.
f. (ण्डः-ण्डी) Pumpkin, gourd.

कुम्भिका (का) 1.
f. An aquatic plant
(Pistia stratiotes); a trumpet
flower; a stye in the eye.

कुम्भीक (कः) 1.
m. A plant (Rot-
tleria tinctoria); a stye.

कुम्भिन् (म्भी) 5.
m. An elephant; a
crocodile; a fish; bdellium.
a.
Having a jar; jar-shaped.

कुम्भिनी-वीज (जं) 1.
n. Croton nut.

कुम्भि-मद (दः) 1.
m. Juice exuding
from the elephant's temples.

कुम्भिल (लः) 1.
m. A thief; a plagia-
rist; wife's brother; a gilt head.

कुम्भील (लः) 1.
m. A crocodile.

कुम्भी-धान्य (न्यः) 1.
m. Grain stored
in jars for a week or year.

कुम्भी-धान्यक (कः) 1.
m. A household-
er keeping such grain.

कुम्भीनस (सः) 1.
m. A large and ve-
nomous snake.
f. The mother
of Lavana, a rakshasa.

कुम्भी-पाक (कः) 1.
m. A hell.

कुम्भीर (रः) 1.
m. A crocodile.

कुम्भीर-मक्षिका (का) 1.
f. A sort of
fly, an aquatic insect.

कुम्भी-वीज (जं) 1.
n. Croton nut.

कूम (मं) 1.
n. A lake, a pond.

कु-मेधस् (धाः-धः)
a. Malicious.
